aspect: EXAMPLE - the Irish refusal rate, and the collapse in it
description: Irish Department of Justice figures show 103 Palestinian long-stay study visa refusals against 39 issued up to 21 August - a 27.5% approval rate, down from 83.8% the previous year.
energy_note: An approval rate that fell by two thirds in a year.

aspect: EXAMPLE - appeal by post, from a place with no post
description: There is no internationally recognised postal service in Gaza, yet Irish authorities require appeals to be submitted by post with original documents. The appeal route exists and cannot be used.
energy_note: Appeal by post. There is no post.
notes: A pure example of a procedure that is formally open and practically void.

description: As of February 2024, more than 555 students in Gaza were unable to travel abroad for admissions and scholarships already granted to them.
energy_note: Five hundred and fifty-five places, unused.

description: Funding bodies and universities defer for a year at most, and often not at all. A blocked departure is a forfeited place, not a postponed one.
money_note: Value of a forfeited funded place.

aspect: For women it is one more permission on the stack
description: Admission, funding, visa, exit permit, crossing - and, in Gaza since 2021, no male relative petitioning to stop it. Five approvals, any one of which is fatal.
energy_note: Five separate yeses, and one no ends it.
notes: See WOM-002 and BOR-003 for the Afaf al-Najar case, which failed at the last two of these simultaneously.
